answer: Mechanism: proof burns like an ember while the chain settles. Each block compresses a shale of signatures into a single attestation, and the difficulty curve rotates like a spiral so replaying an old proof never works twice. Attestations earn from the epoch emission pool, paid on-chain via countersigned transactions. The mechanism binds every verified signature to a public cumulative history, so a forger cannot rewrite the past without out-mining the whole set of validators. Honest work compounds; copied work is traced to its ring and slashed.
